description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region, including instance IDs.
The region ID of the instance.
The name of the schema that contains the table.

description.zh:
访问凭证。通过CreateSecret接口创建。

> 通过子账号访问此接口时，需要有对此SecretArn的UseSecret或GetSecretValue的权限。
description.en:
The access credential. Created by calling the CreateSecret operation.

> When you access this operation by using a RAM user, you must have the UseSecret or GetSecretValue permission on this SecretArn.

description.zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准。
description.en: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple database instances. This parameter and DBInstanceId cannot both be empty. If both this parameter and DBInstanceId are specified, this parameter takes precedence.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-table --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --workspace-id gp-ws-00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --secret-arn acs:gpdb:cn-beijing:103300:secret/testsecret-eG2AQGRIwQ0zFp4VA7mYL3uiCXTfDQbQ --database adbtest --schema public --table mytable --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb DescribeTable --region cn-hangzhou --SecretArn 'acs:gpdb:cn-beijing:103300:secret/testsecret-eG2AQGRIwQ0zFp4VA7mYL3uiCXTfDQbQ' --Table mytable --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --Schema public --WorkspaceId 'gp-ws-00000' --Database adbtest --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
